messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Nothing has changed since we spoke yesterday. Your order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. The Magic M. 40T is still waiting on stock at our warehouse.

Magic M. still expects the units to leave the factory on November 12. That's tomorrow. We'll email you tracking as soon as your miner ships to you. Your Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on is on the same order.

You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is there anything else about the order I can help with?
